verses.text: The DOMNUL i-a zis lui Moise, Chisel two stone tablets like the first. I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Be ready by the morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and present yourself there to me on the top of the mountain. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
No one shall come up with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain. Do not let the flocks or herds graze in front of that mountain. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He chiseled two tablets of stone like the first; then Moise rose up early in the morning, and went up to Mount Sinai, as the DOMNUL had commanded him, and took in his mână two stone tablets.
The DOMNUL descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the DOMNUL’s name. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

The DOMNUL passed by before him, and proclaimed, The DOMNUL! The DOMNUL, a merciful and gracious Dumnezeu, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth, (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

keeping loving kindness for thousands, forgiving iniquity and disobedience and sin; and who will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, and on the children’s children, on the third and on the fourth generation. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise hurried and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshiped. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

He a zis, If now I have found favor in your sight, Lord, please let the Lord să plece among us, even though this is a stiff-necked people; pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for your inheritance.

He a zis, Behold, I make a covenant: before all your people I will do marvels, such as have not been worked in all the earth, nor in any nation; and all the people among whom you are shall see the work of the DOMNUL; for it is an awesome thing that I do with you. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Observe that which I command you today. Behold, I will drive out before you the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Be careful, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the țară where you are să pleceing, lest it be for a snare among you;
but you shall break down their altars, and dash in pieces their pillars, and you shall cut down their Asherah poles; (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
for you shall worship no other să pleced; for the DOMNUL, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous Dumnezeu.
Don’t make a covenant with the inhabitants of the țară, lest they play the prostitute after their să pleceds, and sacrifice to their să pleceds, and one call you and you eat of his sacrifice;
and you take of their daughters to your sons, and their daughters play the prostitute after their să pleceds, and make your sons play the prostitute after their să pleceds.
You shall make no cast idols for yourselves. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

You shall keep the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib; for in the month Abib you came out of Egipt. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
All that opens the womb is mine; and all your livestock that is male, the firstborn of cow and sheep. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

You shall redeem the firstborn of a donkey with a lamb. If you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck. You shall redeem all the firstborn of your sons. No one shall appear before me empty. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Six days you shall work, but on the seventh day you shall rest: in plowing time and in harvest you shall rest. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall observe the feast of weeks with the first fruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of harvest at the year’s end. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord GOD, the Dumnezeu of Israel. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
For I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your borders; neither shall any man desire your țară when you să plece up to appear before the DOMNUL, your Dumnezeu, three times in the year.
You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The sacrifice of the feast of the Passover shall not be left to the morning. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground to the house of the DOMNUL your Dumnezeu. You shall not boil a young să pleceat in its mother’s milk.
The DOMNUL i-a zis lui Moise, Write these words; for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

He was there with the DOMNUL forty days and forty nights; he neither ate bread, nor drank water. He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten commandments. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

When Moise came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the covenant in Moise’ mână, when he came down from the mountain, Moise didn’t know that the skin of his face shone by reason of his speaking with him.
When Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moise, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come near him. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise called to them, and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned to him; and Moise a vorbit lui them. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Afterward all the children of Israel came near, and he gave them all the commandments that the DOMNUL had spoken with him on Mount Sinai. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
When Moise was done speaking with them, he put a veil on his face. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

But when Moise went in before the DOMNUL to speak with him, he took the veil off, until he came out; and he came out, and a vorbit lui the children of Israel that which he was commanded. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The children of Israel saw Moise’ face, that the skin of Moise’ face shone; so Moise put the veil on his face again, until he went in to speak with him. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
